newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures ended higher, off highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures ended higher, off highs.

text.p: Sept 12 - U.S. debt futures ended higher, off peaks. Traders said late afternoon action turned quiet after earlier pullback from peaks. Some tied erosion from highs to Reuters story quoting Fed source. They saw dealer, big local liquidation after Dec T-bonds stalled at highs. Aug US CPI seen up 0.2 pct. Retail sales seen up 0.7 pct, ex-autos up 0.4 pct. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
